Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in comparing the magnitudes of subatomic particle masses. It incorrectly stated that an electron (mass ≈ 9.11×10^-31 kg) is heavier than a proton (mass ≈ 1.67×10^-27 kg) simply because the exponent 31 is greater than 27. In scientific notation, a larger negative exponent indicates a smaller number (10^-31 is much smaller than 10^-27). Consequently, the Planner concluded that losing a proton results in the least mass loss, whereas in reality, the electron is the lightest particle listed, so losing an electron results in the least mass loss.
